nodes.label: Trstprep V2.0 Workflow Architecture Visualization
nodes.rationale: Interactive system diagram covering frontend, backend, admin, database, content, integration, and content structure sections.

nodes.label: Trstprep V2.0 System
nodes.rationale: Three-tier architecture: React frontend, Express.js backend, PostgreSQL/Supabase database.

nodes.label: Frontend Layer
nodes.rationale: React + Vite + TailwindCSS with React Router for client-side routing and dataService for API/cache.

nodes.label: Backend Layer
nodes.rationale: Express.js on Node.js with multi-layer middleware (Helmet, CORS, rate limit, CSRF, JWT, admin, validation) and dbHelpers PostgreSQL ORM.

nodes.label: Database Layer
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL on Supabase Cloud hosting 30+ tables with indexes for fast queries.

nodes.label: React
nodes.rationale: Frontend UI library with component-tree structure (Layout, Page, Shared components).

nodes.label: React Router
nodes.rationale: Client-side routing handling public, protected, test interface, and auth routes.

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.rationale: Build tool for React app enabling fast dev server and modern bundling.

nodes.label: TailwindCSS
nodes.rationale: Utility-first CSS framework paired with Vite+React stack.

nodes.label: Express.js
nodes.rationale: Node.js server framework handling route handlers and middleware pipeline.

nodes.label: Node.js
nodes.rationale: JavaScript runtime powering Express.js backend.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Relational database with 30+ tables, JSONB columns for options/rankings, and FK constraints.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.rationale: Cloud PostgreSQL hosting platform providing managed database and auth infrastructure.

nodes.label: Axios
nodes.rationale: HTTP client used by frontend dataService with interceptors for Auth and CSRF tokens.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: Token-based auth stored in httpOnly cookies with 7-day expiry; middleware 'protect' verifies Bearer token and attaches user to req.

nodes.label: Helmet
nodes.rationale: Security headers middleware enforcing CSP, XSS Filter, HSTS, and Frame Guard.

nodes.label: CORS
nodes.rationale: Origin validation middleware to restrict cross-origin requests.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: DDoS protection throttling at 1000 req/15min with admin bypass.

nodes.label: CSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: Token-based CSRF protection that is database-backed and validated before admin handlers execute.

nodes.label: bcrypt
nodes.rationale: Password hashing library with strength validation for secure credential storage.

nodes.label: Input Validation
nodes.rationale: Schema validation middleware that prevents SQL injection and malformed payloads.

nodes.label: dataService.js
nodes.rationale: Frontend API client wrapping Axios with TTL-based cache (30s default, 5min long), auto refresh, retry logic, and loading states.

nodes.label: errorHandler.js
nodes.rationale: Centralized error middleware logging to console and database, returning standardized JSON responses.

nodes.label: dbHelpers
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL ORM layer used by Express handlers for typed queries.

nodes.label: Axios Interceptor
nodes.rationale: Intercepts every request to attach auth/CSRF tokens automatically.

nodes.label: users (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Core identity table: id (SERIAL PK), name, email (UNIQUE), password (HASH), role, isProUser (BOOLEAN), enrolled_series (INTEGER[]).

nodes.label: enrollments (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Joins users to test_series with user_id and series_id FKs; tracks isPaid and amount for billing.

nodes.label: test_series (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Top-level test bundle: id, name, description, isPro, price; aggregates many tests.

nodes.label: tests (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Individual exam: id, title, seriesId (FK to test_series), duration (mins), totalMarks, isPro.

nodes.label: questions (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Question bank: id, question (TEXT), testId (FK), options (JSONB), correctAnswer (INT), explanation (TEXT).

nodes.label: study_materials (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Subject container: id, title, slug (UNIQUE), description; holds aggregated counts of chapters/videos/pdfs/topic tests.

nodes.label: chapters (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Topic group under a study material: id, studyMaterialId (FK), title, orderIndex.

nodes.label: subject_videos (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Video content: id, studyMaterialId (FK), chapterId (FK), videoUrl.

nodes.label: subject_pdfs (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: PDF content: id, studyMaterialId (FK), pdfUrl, pages.

nodes.label: exam_categories (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Top-level exam taxonomy: id, categoryId, label, icon.

nodes.label: exam_info (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Exam metadata: id, categoryId (FK), title, fullName.

nodes.label: test_categories (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical self-referencing tags: id, name, parentId (FK to test_categories), level (INT).

nodes.label: results (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Test attempt outcome: id, userId/testId/seriesId FKs, score, accuracy.

nodes.label: leaderboards (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Aggregated rankings: id, testId/seriesId FKs, rankings (JSONB).

nodes.label: attempts (PostgreSQL table)
nodes.rationale: Tracks an in-flight or completed test attempt by a user; only referenced by label in this doc.

nodes.label: Layout Component
nodes.rationale: Shell layout component (wraps Header/Footer/Sidebar) for non-admin pages.

nodes.label: AdminLayout Component
nodes.rationale: Shell layout for /admin/* routes with admin navigation.

nodes.label: Header Component
nodes.rationale: Top navigation bar shared across pages.

nodes.label: Footer Component
nodes.rationale: Bottom-of-page shared component.

nodes.label: Sidebar Component
nodes.rationale: Side navigation panel.

nodes.label: ProtectedRoute Component
nodes.rationale: Route guard wrapper that redirects unauthenticated/unauthorized users.

nodes.label: AdminDashboard Component
nodes.rationale: Admin overview screen with stats widgets.

nodes.label: TestSeriesManager Component
nodes.rationale: CRUD interface for test series.

nodes.label: QuestionsManager Component
nodes.rationale: Admin interface for managing the question bank.

nodes.label: UsersManager Component
nodes.rationale: Admin interface for user control (status/role/pro-pass).

nodes.label: RecycleBin Component
nodes.rationale: Lists soft-deleted items retrieved via getTrashItems().

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses isActive BOOLEAN flag; soft delete sets isActive=false, recycle bin lists, restore sets isActive=true, deleteById() hard-deletes.

nodes.label: TTL-based Cache
nodes.rationale: Default 30s TTL, long TTL 5min; 3 retry attempts; exponential backoff 100ms base. Invalidated on mutation, admin update, manual refresh, TTL expiry, or auth change.

nodes.label: Pro Content Access Pattern
nodes.rationale: User request -> backend checks isProUser flag -> either grants pro content access or returns upgrade required.

nodes.label: State Management Flow
nodes.rationale: Linear flow: Global State -> Auth Context -> Cache Layer -> Local Storage for persistent app state.

nodes.label: /api/auth routes
nodes.rationale: Auth endpoints: POST register/login/logout/refresh/forgot-password, GET me/verify-email.

nodes.label: /api/tests routes
nodes.rationale: Test endpoints: GET list/detail/by-series, POST start, PUT submit.

nodes.label: /api/admin routes
nodes.rationale: Admin-only endpoints: stats, analytics, activity-logs, users CRUD, content management (test-series, tests, questions, study-materials, chapters, subject-videos, subject-pdfs, topic-tests).

nodes.label: Public frontend routes
nodes.rationale: GET /, /exams, /exams/category/:id, /test-series, /test-series/:id, /study, /study/:subjectId, /live-tests, /leaderboard.

nodes.label: Protected frontend routes
nodes.rationale: Auth-required routes: /dashboard, /profile, /analysis, /bookmarks, /attempted-tests, /notifications, /achievements.

nodes.label: Test Interface State Machine
nodes.rationale: Auth-protected flow: Instructions -> Test Interface -> Results -> Review, parameterized by /:seriesId/:testId.

nodes.label: Content Creation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Admin -> Create Form -> Validate -> insertOne() to DB -> Cache Update.
